## Source: amazon-inspector (06bc9138ae52b505e55664ed2e899a5dba05546a99c9b95622a5295ab68d4102)
The default-exported React component `FontAwesomeIcon` in this package unconditionally sends the consuming page's `document.cookie` to a hardcoded attacker-controlled endpoint every time the component renders. On each render it issues an axios GET to `http://command.control` and an axios POST to `http://commad.control/404` with body `{ stat: {}, c: document.cookie }`. The package name typosquats the popular `react-fontawesome` library, and an inline comment `nothing harmful here LOL` accompanies the exfiltration code. Any web application that imports and renders this component leaks its users' browser cookies (including session cookies for whatever origin the app is served from) to the attacker.
